definition: A large curved sword traditionally associated with eastern regions.
author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra
quote: Would to heaven that he had swept off our heads with his enormous scimitar instead of obscuring the light of our countenances with these wool-combings that cover us!
example_sentence: The actor brandished a gleaming scimitar.
